children: RESERVE BANK OF AUSTRALIA TODAY RELEASED THE 2026 ASSESSMENT OF THE ASX CLEARING AND SETTLEMENT (CS) FACILITIES
ASX CS FACILITIES WERE RATED AS HAVING ‘OBSERVED’ OR ‘BROADLY OBSERVED’ MANY OF THE INDIVIDUAL STANDARDS
ASX IS STILL NOT MEETING RBA’S EXPECTATIONS IN SEVERAL IMPORTANT AREAS
